'''Unna Lettu''' was a [[Artist/Legends|painter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]],<ref name="DoE" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Lettu was considered the planet's most famous painter<ref name="DoE" /> by [[980 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', which mentions Unna Lettu, is dated to [[980 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] owned several of Lettu's landscapes, which he set for display in [[Set Harth's mansion|his mansion]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="DoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unna Lettu was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="DoE" />
